sources.name: Pumps QCO 2023 — search-result summary
sources.publisher: Department for Promotion of Industry and Internal Trade (DPIIT)
sources.notes: Search results confirm a Pumps (Quality Control) Order 2023 was proposed by DPIIT covering IS 8034:2018 and IS 14220:2018, mandating ISI Mark. Enforcement date was cited as 'to be announced'. No official gazette number or effective date was confirmed in accessible sources. This record is a secondary summary only — not a primary gazette citation.

evidence.text: BIS describes IS 14220:2018 as Openwell Submersible Pumpsets and discusses agriculture and irrigation applications.

evidence.source_name: BIS Government Procurement pump standards booklet
evidence.text: BIS describes IS 8034:2018 as Submersible Pumpsets used for clear, cold water in agriculture and water supply, commonly in boreholes/borewells/tubewells.

evidence.source_name: BIS Government Procurement pump standards booklet
evidence.text: BIS booklet identifies IS 9079:2018 as Monoset Pumps for Clear, Cold Water for Agricultural and Water Supply.
IS 8034:2002 was revised as IS 8034:2018 and the old standard would stand withdrawn after 04-04-2019.
IS 8034:2018 guideline records IS 9283 (line-operated a.c. motors for submersible pumpsets) as a normative reference for the motor component of submersible pumpsets.
IS 8034:2018 guideline records IS 14536 (Code of practice for selection, installation, operation and maintenance of submersible pumpset) as a normative reference.
IS 8034:2018 guideline records IS 11346 (Tests for agricultural and water supply pumps — Code of acceptance) as the hydraulic performance test method reference.
2026 BIS committee material lists revision work for IS 14220:2018.
2026 BIS committee material lists revision work for IS 8034:2018.
2026 BIS committee material lists revision work for IS 9079:2018.
BIS committee material lists IS 14536:2018 as Selection, installation, operation and maintenance of submersible pumpset - Code of practice (First Revision).

BIS MED 20 committee material lists IS 9283 (Line operated a.c. motors for submersible pumpsets — Specification) as a standard under the submersible pumpset committee. Current revision noted as IS 9283:2024 on BIS portal.
BIS MED 20 committee material lists IS 11346:2002 (Tests for agricultural and water supply pumps — Code of acceptance) as the hydraulic performance testing standard under Committee MED 20.
BIS MED 20 committee material lists IS 10572:1983 (Methods of sampling for pumps) as a sampling standard under Committee MED 20.

Secondary search results confirm Pumps (Quality Control) Order 2023 proposed by DPIIT covers IS 8034:2018 (Submersible Pumpsets) and IS 14220:2018 (Openwell Submersible Pumpsets), requiring ISI Mark under BIS Scheme-I. Enforcement date cited as 'to be announced'. No official gazette number or effective date confirmed.

standards.title: Openwell Submersible Pumpsets
standards.scope: Openwell submersible pumpsets for clear, cold water, including agriculture and irrigation applications described in BIS summary material.

standards.title: Submersible Pumpsets
standards.scope: Submersible pumpsets for clear, cold water, commonly used in boreholes/borewells/tubewells for agriculture and water supply.

standards.title: Monoset Pumps for Clear, Cold Water for Agricultural and Water Supply
standards.scope: Monoset pumps for clear, cold water for agricultural and water supply purposes.

standards.title: Selection, Installation, Operation and Maintenance of Submersible Pumpset — Code of Practice
standards.scope: Code of practice for selection, installation, operation and maintenance of submersible pumpset, as listed in BIS committee material.

standards.title: Line Operated A.C. Motors for Submersible Pumpsets — Specification
standards.scope: Specification for line-operated a.c. motors designed for use in submersible pumpsets. Normative reference of IS 8034:2018.

standards.title: Tests for Agricultural and Water Supply Pumps — Code of Acceptance
standards.scope: Code of acceptance for hydraulic performance testing of pumps used in agricultural and water supply applications. Referenced by IS 8034:2018 and IS 9079:2018.

standards.title: Methods of Sampling for Pumps
standards.scope: Methods of sampling and criteria for conformity for pumps, used in BIS certification under Committee MED 20.
